text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a regression in the GQA path for 70B on H100 when seqlen spikes above ~4096. p50 tokens/sec down ~18%. Suspect kernel-picker routed to small-block GQA kernels that thrash the KV layout.

maria: Can you paste the profiler traces / perf numbers?

alex: Quick dump from the nightly run:```
model: redwood-70b-gqa
hw: h100-80gb
seqlen: 4096 -> 8192 (generation)
baseline (old-picker): 1200 toks/s
current (master): 980 toks/s
hotspots: paged_attn_kernel_small_block (35%), kvcache_read (22%), kernel_selector (12%)
```

sam: Interesting. Small-block paged-attn looks like it increases kernel launch overhead and non-coalesced loads. Could be the picker prefers MQA/GQA small-block path because of avg seqlen histogram bias.

kai: Also see this hardware diff: Ampere had better L2-caching behavior for those strided accesses. H100 prefetch changes amplify penalty for non-contiguous KV layout.

ashley: Do we have the KV layout variants tested? interleaved vs contiguous vs sharded-page? I remember a perf delta last quarter.

alex: I ran 3 layout configs in perfbench:```
configs: interleaved, contiguous, page-sharded
seqlen=8192
interleaved: 980 toks/s
contiguous: 1130 toks/s
page-sharded (+prefetch=2): 1195 toks/s
```

maria: Page-sharded + prefetch looks best. That suggests thrash from interleaving across lanes. Good find.

sam: For autotune we should make picker sequence-length-aware and hw-aware. Proposed simple rule: if seqlen > 4096 -> prefer contiguous or page-sharded kernels and larger blocksz (>=512). Else use small-block MQA for latency-sensitive workloads.

alex: Agreed. Also we should add a penalty term in the cost model for non-coalesced KV read stalls on H100. Right now cost model ignores prefetch misses.

ashley: Quick experiment plan I can run this week: create a 4-way autotune sweep: blocksz=[256,512,1024], kv_layout=[contiguous,page-sharded], prefetch_window=[1,2]. Run sample load 10k requests across seqlen distribution.

sam: That config matrix seems fine. Add a flag to the picker to record chosen kernel and cost components in trace so we can post-hoc analyze selection frequency.

perf-bot: Automated run summary (this morning):
- nightly-master vs candidate-autotune-2026-03-17
- metric: toks/s@p50 across seqlen buckets
- candidate shows +12% for seqlen>4096 on H100, neutral for <2048
- failure cases: transient OOMs when blocksz=1024 + batch_size>4 (need safety check)

kai: OOM note is important — we need picker to be memory-aware. Add a memory budget check pre-select.

maria: Action items:
- @ashley run the 4-way sweep and upload traces (owner: ashley) :rocket:
- @sam add trace logging for picker decision and cost components (owner: sam)
- @alex add cost penalty term for non-coalesced kvcache reads and a hw profile map (owner: alex)
- @kai validate H100 prefetch modeling and add to runtime hw DB (owner: kai)

alex: I'll start a draft PR for the picker change and link the bench results. Expect initial patch by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: If page-sharded wins consistently we should consider making it the default for large seqlens, but gate by a canary deployment first.

ashley: Will do the canary plan in the sweep results doc. I'll attach perf graphs and a small flamegraph for kvcache_read.

alex: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the canonical perf thread for the incident.
